evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not review conclusions. Direct ordinary senses and actual English labels govern symmetric nontransitive guards; topic/category similarity alone is insufficient.
消耗 safeguards actual resource consumption and tired/exhausted labels, including へとへと/ぼろぼろ; the same English fatigue label can fit a noun or state without full Japanese substitutability.
省略 safeguards actual omit/remove/skip/delete senses, including 飛ばす and 削る's complete relevant families; 略語 is a resulting short expression, not necessarily the action.
食塩 safeguards broader culinary 塩. 職人 safeguards 技師's technical/skilled-worker overlap without equating all employees with artisans.
初旬/上旬 have exactly equal titles, already deduplicated. Broader beginning labels 初め/始め/最初/始まり need direct guards independently.
食器 safeguards 皿/お皿's dishes labels, not an inferred clique of every implement. ショップ/店 share an exact title; 商店 separately needs a guard.
書道 safeguards 習字 and actual 字/筆 penmanship senses, not a subject-matter-only clique with all arts, characters or practice.
白髪 safeguards broader hair labels 髪/髪の毛/毛 without making all hair white. シリーズ safeguards actual series/continuation labels 連続/続き, not every related work.
汁 safeguards ジュース/スープ's ordinary juice/soup labels. つゆ-only dipping sauce is not selected; no sauce-based exclusion is inferred.
初級, 助教授, 知り合い, 私立 and 素人 have no authored declarations; assess actual meaning ambiguity independently rather than requiring a quota.
sourceAccessLimits: Sixteen new cards and four narrow reuses cover community-list rows N2:782-N2:801; not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Three new-article reciprocal pairs: 省/省略, 略/省略 and 塩/食塩. Reused しょうゆ/油 gains navigation; unchanged 籍 already reciprocally links reused 書籍. No new kanji/strokes.
しょうゆ retains its stable kana identity, N5 level and empty kanji metadata; only the existing 醤油 explanation gains the 油 link/reading. 書籍/書店/資料 gain only sourced jlpt 2.

Raw source fields remain verbatim; teaching selects applicable spelling/reading/senses. 知合い is a search-only spelling flag, not proof of invalidity or frequency. 白髪's trendy hair bleaching gloss is not an independently supported sense.
汁/しる is restricted to 汁, not 液 or the つゆ-only dipping-sauce sense. 素人 is a whole-word irregular reading without invented component values.
Original broad captures are not wholly inspected; explicit inventories distinguish 121 inspected complete families, 66 complete existing bodies and the distinct inspected labels.
The MEXT proposal is not implementation-date evidence. Public bodies and receipts are author captures, not reviewers' own fresh retrievals.
No production quiz draws, exhaustive baseline rereview, measured learning outcomes or native-speaker certification. The blind derivative omits only quizGuardRationale.
